author: emilygraceillustration
title: Storyboard Artist Wanted for Animatic
content: STORYBOARD ARTIST WANTED! 🎬 I'm looking for a talented freelance storyboard artist to collaborate on a short proof-of-concept animatic for an original animated action-adventure series. I'm particularly keen to hear from artists who specialise in dynamic action sequences, cinematic composition and strong character moments. This is a paid opportunity for a small, creator-led project. If you're interested, or know someone who might be a great fit, please get in touch or tag them below. Please share your portfolio/reel and rates via DM. Thanks!

author: dalluyonstudio
title: Looking for Graphic Artist (Freelance)
content: WE ARE LOOKING FOR GRAPHIC ARTIST AND VIDEO EDITOR! Job Title: Graphic Artist (Freelance) The Role: You will work closely with our social media manager. We are not only looking for someone with a sharp eye for design but also someone meticulous with text placement (such as CTA) and image compositions that convert viewers into followers, players, wishlisters, etc. Moreover, we need someone who is proactive with design suggestions and reflects brand elements surrounding Philippine culture & tradition incorporated into our games. Key Responsibilities: - Create game content poster layouts and graphic images for social media use. Use digital illustration, photo editing software, and layout software to create designs. - Collaborate with the social media team and production team to develop creative solutions. - Follow brand guidelines, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and revision feedback efficiently. author: aionlabo
title: CG Storyboard Artist at Atomic Cartoons
content: Atomic Cartoons seeks a CG Storyboard Artist for an ongoing animated series. Applicants need 2+ years' relevant CG storyboarding experience, Storyboard Pro skills and current legal eligibility to work in Canada. Documented BC residency as of 31 December 2025 is required. Remote work is available within British Columbia; Vancouver and Lower Mainland artists may choose hybrid or studio work. CAD1,500–1,800 per week. No application deadline or contract duration stated. Apply through the employer's form. Read our English article: https://www.aionlabo.com/en/post/atomic-cartoons-cg-storyboard-artist-8013727003-2026-en #Storyboard #AnimationJobs #CreativeJobs
